text_block_list.text:
Summer camp was approaching its second half.
"Let's make this a fruitful camp"—
we had said, but...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Phew...
During a light jog, Daiichi Ruby tripped and fell.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I simply got caught in the sand.
There is no issue.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I have not done so.

I heard she had some issues with her legs before, so I was worried...
but there really doesn't seem to be any problem.
However...
choice_data_list: (Fatigue has really built up in her...)

text_block_list.text: Ever since summer training camp began, Daiichi Ruby had been pushing herself relentlessly, day and night.

It's all to produce results in the final leg
of the Triple Tiara awaiting after the Rose Stakes,
the Shuka Sho, but—
choice_data_list: (I still haven't found her best form at medium distance...)

text_block_list.text:
Training had hit a complete dead end.
I want to give her a major refresh, but she likely wouldn't want that—
choice_data_list: Wait, Helios, when did you get here?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ayyy~âª
I'm always down to feature alongside the Ladyâ

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, didn't you just wipe out, Ojou!?
You good?"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I am fine.
My apologies for showing you such an unsightly side of myself.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Nope!
More like, a heart-throbbing urge to protect them?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I am seriously the luckiest Umamusume ever!
Meeting you, Milady—tysm, big love~♪

Taking a break, I let myself get swept up in Daitaku Helios's
energy. Talking with someone who's my exact opposite
should be a great change of pace... hopefully.
choice_data_list: Is Helios on break right now?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
She just casually came to hang out!
choice_data_list: Huh? So that means right now...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"In the middle of training!
Still all good, though!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Tbh, it's all about the vibe☆
When you find someone you're crushin' on, you just gotta dive right in~!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I apologize for worrying you earlier.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"However, as you can see, I am perfectly fine.
Please return to your own practice."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, already?!
I wanna hang out more!

Daiichi Ruby has yet to feel refreshed.
With no way to break the stagnation, I just want her to relax even a little, but...
choice_data_list: W-Well then, why don't you practice together!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
That's so hype!
As expected of Ruby's Trainer☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
My top training recs are
either the Hype Plank Fest or The Chat Endurance!

"I wasn't quite sure, but since I could at least
imagine what it was compared to the other one, I picked it.
With planks, there's less risk of injury anyway."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ayy ayyy!
Roger!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Trainer.
choice_data_list: Core strength is essential for everything, after all!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Yep, live from the festival venue~~!!

Led by Daitaku Helios into one of the rooms at the
training camp... I found it had been turned completely
into a nightclub.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Me and the crew just winged it and somehow made this☆ Everyone's already getting started!

text_block_list.name: Helios's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
Fuuuu!
Planking is the best-!

Moving to the upbeat music, the Umamusume
perform various exercises like spider planks
and mountain climbers...

text_block_list.name: Helios's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
Hey! You two over there, don't just stand there—
Ah, D-Daiichi Ruby-san...!

text_block_list.name: Helios's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
Yo, DJ, what are you doing?!
Helios's special guest is here!!
Change the beat!!

text_block_list.name: DJ Umamusume
text_block_list.text: K!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Whew~~, nice DJing☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Milady!! I'll be your escort!
Let's do planks together♪

The interior is entirely that of a club, but it has a nice atmosphere.
As everyone watches on, Daiichi Ruby...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I will have to politely decline.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Pien!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I guess this kind of thing really is
a total no-go for an ojousama~.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: It is unnecessary for me, but...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
For some, music and bonding with peers
create a synergistic effect
in their training.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I believe it is commendable to devise
the method that proves most effective for yourself.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: I wuuuv it so muuuuch!!

Beside the hyped-up Daitaku Helios,
Daiichi Ruby seemed to tune in to the music for just a brief moment.

And even after parting ways with Daitaku Helios,
the training continued—

I haven't the slightest idea, but maybe what I need right now
is a fresh perspective...
Thinking that, I made a deliberate choice.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah, awesome!
Leave it to me!!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
First, I'd like you to show me
how it's done, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: It's likely a training method they're unfamiliar with.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
First, please experience it for yourself
before deciding whether you need it.

I can certainly understand Daiichi Ruby's point.
Even considering that she could rest while I take over—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay☆
This way then!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: —And then we were like, 'Wait, Palmer-chin, isn't that super emotional?' kinda vibe~

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: It was like, "Guess we gotta splash each other now!?" We ran into the sea and immediately went ker-splash! Like, total soakfest!? You know!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
And get this, it's hilarious!
Palma-chin was totally wearing a swimsuit under her jersey!
Total cheat code, right??

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Nuh-uh~, it's out of pure love~☆
Palmer-chin figured we'd hit the beach right away,
so she wore it straight from the academy!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: "Isn't that wild? No matter how you look at it, she totally loves me way too much! That's what makes us BFFs, y'know? And then the Jo-City pair—"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hm?
choice_data_list: What kind of training is this...?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: The Ultimate Talkathon!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: "I talk a ton, but my friend told me some people find it 'unbearable'?!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Then like, training it is, lol!
That kinda vibe!
choice_data_list: Is this training to test my endurance listening to your chattering?
Is this endurance training for listening to you chat?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Bingo☆

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
you've reached your decision, I presume.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
The training proposed by Ms. Helios...
Is it truly necessary for me?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh!?
Not even a laugh!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: ...Eh, whatever♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hmm~?
Nihihi... It's a secret☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Seriously so cute...♪

And even after parting ways with Daitaku Helios,
the training continued—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...
choice_data_list: Ruby, you should take a break soon

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
No... not yet.
I'm going to run just one more lap.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: If I can just run one more, maybe I'll—
choice_data_list: ...Can you find a lead or something?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...No, my apologies.
Let's wrap things up for today.
choice_data_list: Let's do that. Good work today.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Yes, good work.

In the end, no way to break through the current impasse was found.
It was about time to make a decision.
choice_data_list: (Do I keep challenging myself, or play it safe...?)

text_block_list.text:
When I visited Daiichi Ruby's family estate before,
I learned the history and achievements of the "Illustrious Lineage,"
and I like to think I understand her feelings toward the royal road.

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Mother
text_block_list.text: "—May you discover her 'greatest radiance.'"

What is the path where Daiichi Ruby can shine brightest?
I already know the answer to thatâ
choice_data_list: (—I should suggest she switch to sprints)

text_block_list.text:
Even if it went against her wishes,
as the trainer of the "Illustrious Clan"...
I made my decision—
